== Notes ==
* This skill takes effect as soon as damage is dealt. When triggered by an attack or skill that also applies a condition, that condition will be removed only if it is applied before the damage is dealt.
** Condition-applying [[attack skill]]s and [[preparation]]s apply their conditions after the attack damage is dealt; Weapon of Remedy will not remove these conditions.
** [[Enchantment]]s such as [[Grenth's Grasp]] and [[Double Dragon]] which add a condition application to subsequent attacks or skills trigger before damage is dealt, allowing Weapon of Remedy to remove their conditions immediately if triggered by the same action.
** Some spells, such as [[Immolate]], deal damage before applying their conditions, whereas others, such as [[Eruption]], apply conditions first. {{research needed|Lots more skills to test, if it's worth doing so. See talk page}}
{{Bug| If used when taking damage from multiple sources from only one attack, Weapon of Remedy will trigger multiple times. For example, if a foe hexed with [[Barbs]] takes physical damage, Weapon of Remedy will trigger both for the physical damage and for the Barbs damage.}}
